name: Pricing toggle
oneLiner: a three-plan glass pricing table rises in, a pointer flips the billing toggle from monthly to yearly, every price rolls down its digits like a counter, a green save chip pops beside the toggle, then the middle plan lifts forward with a lit ring and a Most popular badge while the others step back
say: when the speaker says go yearly, talks about plans or names the tier most people pick ('switch to annual and it drops to 23', 'most people go for Pro'): the toggle flips on 'yearly', the plan lifts on its name
